name: body
purpose: One part of a scene: a shape, a textured planet, a map, a ring, or a group that holds other bodies. A state key in at, rot or scale moves it. With drag, the learner moves it.
binds: optional state keys in at, rot, scale, t, glow and show; to is the state key that a drag writes
keys: with drag: A/D or ←/→ move the grip, ⇧ for ten steps

id.doc: the body id; force, label3d, in and close:<id> name it

kind.doc: the shape; plane [w, d], ring [inner, outer] and disc [r] lie flat; map is a flat piece of the world picture (needs uv); globe is the world picture on a ball; a group has no shape and holds other bodies

size.doc: box [x, y, z]; cylinder [radius, height] or [top radius, bottom radius, height]; cone and capsule [radius, height]; sphere and disc [radius]; torus [radius, tube]; plane [width, depth]; ring [inner, outer]

at.doc: the place [x, y, z] in the frame of the parent body (y is up); an item can be a state key, and the body then follows the state at once. With coords geo or globe: [lon, lat, height]

rot.doc: the turn in degrees about x, y and z; an item can be a state key

pivot.doc: the point that rot turns about, in the same frame as at; at if left out

in.doc: the id of a body above this one; this body moves and turns with it

color.doc: a palette name; the scene takes the colours from the page theme

round.doc: box only: the edge radius as a share of the smallest side

turn.doc: the time in ms that a change of rot takes

show.doc: a state key; the body shows when its value is true

step.doc: the body shows from this step of the scene

scale.doc: the size factor [x, y, z], default [1, 1, 1]; an item can be a state key, so a bar can grow

texture.doc: a picture wrapped on the body, lit by the lamps of the scene; earth is the world map (a sphere, a globe or a map), moon is the Moon

uv.doc: [lon0, lat0, lon1, lat1]: the window of the world picture that a plane or a map shows; a map is that many degrees wide

glow.doc: a halo round the body, from 0 (small) to 1 (wide); the body shines with no shading, as a lamp

light.doc: the body lights the lit bodies of the scene, as the Sun does

opacity.doc: how solid the body is; 1 if left out

along.doc: the id of a path (a body in the world): the body sits on that path at t

t.doc: with along: the place on the path, 0 at its start and 1 at its end; a key lets a slider walk the body

spin.doc: degrees of turn about y in one second; with reduced motion it stands still

drag.doc: the learner drags a grip on the body: orbit turns it round an axis (the key to gets the angle in degrees, for the place cos(a) in x and -sin(a) in z), x, y or z slides it (to gets the place)

to.doc: with drag: the state key that the grip writes; it must be an input in state

about.doc: with orbit or drag orbit: the centre, [0, 0, 0] if left out

axis.doc: with orbit or drag orbit: the axis across the plane of the circle, [0, 1, 0] if left out

range.doc: with drag: the least and most value of to

nudge.doc: with drag: the size of one key press; 1 degree for orbit and 0.1 for x, y and z

label.doc: with drag: what the grip moves, for screen readers

orbit.doc: the body sits on a circle of this radius round about, across axis, at the angle angle; a key lets a slider or a drag move it round

angle.doc: with orbit: the angle in degrees; 0 is along x, 90 is along -z for the axis [0, 1, 0]

arc.doc: ring and disc only: the angles [from, to] in degrees that the shape covers, 0 to 360 if left out; an item can be a state key, so a sector follows the state
